"""Fast differential test of the peeling stage alone."""
import random, sys, importlib.util
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import ref

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m','/workspace/submission/main.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)


def compare(paths, ixps, tag):
    agg = ref.aggregate([(tuple(p), c) for p, c in paths], set(ixps))
    la, ra, fa = ref.peel_naive(agg)
    lb, rb, fb = m._peel(list(agg.items()))
    core_a = {ref.canon(p[i], p[i+1]) for p in fa for i in range(len(p)-1)}
    core_b = {m._canon(p[i], p[i+1]) for p, _c in fb for i in range(len(p)-1)}
    if la != lb or ra != rb or core_a != core_b:
        print('MISMATCH', tag)
        print(' paths', paths, 'ixps', ixps)
        print(' naive links', sorted(la), 'rounds', ra)
        print(' fast  links', sorted(lb), 'rounds', rb)
        print(' core naive', sorted(core_a))
        print(' core fast ', sorted(core_b))
        return False
    return True


def main():
    seed = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 0
    n = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 2000
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    bad = 0
    for t in range(n):
        pool = rng.sample(range(1, 60), rng.randint(2, 10))
        ixps = rng.sample(pool, rng.randint(0, 2))
        npath = rng.randint(0, 8)
        paths = []
        for _ in range(npath):
            k = rng.randint(0, 10)
            p = [rng.choice(pool) for _ in range(k)]
            if rng.random() < 0.3 and p:
                p.append(rng.choice(p))
            if rng.random() < 0.3 and p:
                p = p[::-1]
            paths.append((p, rng.randint(1, 5)))
        if not compare(paths, ixps, 'trial %d' % t):
            bad += 1
            if bad > 3:
                break
    print('peeling mismatches:', bad, 'trials:', n)
    return 1 if bad else 0


sys.exit(main())
